UserCounterData.title: UserCounterData
UserCounterData.description: Stores the current counter value, target goal, and last update timestamp for a specific user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserCounterData entity, corresponding to the user's ID.

targetGoal.description: The user's set target goal for the counter (e.g., 108, 1008).

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp indicating when the counter data was last updated.

CounterHistoryEntry.title: CounterHistoryEntry
CounterHistoryEntry.description: Records a specific counter value at a particular point in time for a user, forming part of the counter history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CounterHistoryEntry entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserCounterData entity this history entry belongs to. (Relationship: UserCounterData 1:N CounterHistoryEntry)

recordedCount.description: The counter value recorded at this history point.

recordDate.description: Timestamp indicating when this counter history entry was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores the current counter value, target goal, and last update timestamp for a specific user. The document ID is the user's ID (`userId` wildcard). This path provides direct access to the user's primary counter data, ensuring private ownership and supporting Authorization Independence. The `id` field in the schema is implicitly matched by the document ID.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyEntryId}.description: Stores historical counter entries for a specific user. Each document includes the `userId` field for denormalized authorization context, directly supporting Authorization Independence and enabling simple, robust security rules. Access is strictly restricted to the owner of the parent user document, and listing is secure.
